# ui::IconGlyph

Header: `winui/render/IconGlyph.hpp`.

One symbol-font glyph, the way every Fluent control draws its small marks (checkmark, chevron, overflow "more"): a codepoint, a font family and a default size.

A plain aggregate, so an app declares any glyph the `glyphs::` table doesn't name. Draw one with [draw_icon()](namespace-ui.md#draw_icon); it converts implicitly to an [IconSource](icon-source.md) for controls that take an icon.

Example: 
```cpp
const ui::Rect icon_rect{0, 0, 16, 16};
const ui::Rect chevron_rect{100, 0, 16, 16};

constexpr ui::IconGlyph ZoomIn{0xE8A3}; // Segoe Fluent Icons "ZoomIn", 12 DIPs
ui::draw_icon(renderer, ZoomIn, icon_rect, theme.palette.text_fill_primary);
ui::draw_icon(renderer, ui::glyphs::ChevronDown, chevron_rect, theme.colors().text, 0.0f,
              theme.icon_font_family); // the era's symbol font
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `codepoint` | `char32_t` | `0` | A Segoe Fluent Icons codepoint, zero in a default-constructed glyph. Every glyph in `glyphs::` sits in the Private Use Area (U+E000-U+F8FF) and fits one UTF-16 code unit. [draw_icon()](namespace-ui.md#draw_icon) doesn't handle surrogate pairs. |
| `font_family` | `FontName` | `"Segoe Fluent Icons"` | The symbol font. |
| `size` | `float` | `12.0f` | Default font size in DIPs, used when [draw_icon()](namespace-ui.md#draw_icon) gets no size override. |
